**In one line**: Inherent, a startup founded by former DeepMind staff, says its AI "teammate" outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI models on a research-replication benchmark.

### Key points
- Inherent is reportedly founded by alumni of Google DeepMind.
- It positions its AI as a research "teammate" rather than a general chatbot.
- The company says the system scored higher than Anthropic and OpenAI models at reproducing existing papers and experimental results.
- The claim comes from the company itself; no independent third-party verification has been published yet.

### Why it matters
Research replication is both a bottleneck for scientific reliability and a yardstick for how much AI can contribute to real knowledge work. If a startup's claim of beating frontier-lab models on a specific task holds up, it would sharpen the contest between general-purpose large models and task-specialized AI.
